presets.name: Research
presets.description: Milestone 7: the whole treble, F3-A6, five ranks per key -- L, M−, M, M+, H -- tuned to A440, opened by the 14 registers, a reed for each way the bellows moves (CC 80), one bellows the arm pushes, and a cassotto for L and M (off by default). Every reed is scaled from the F4 the IfM Zwota measured.
